messages.subject: Re: blavaan - latent change score models

et,

Yes, though some of those models can be relatively low on sampling
efficiency. A good resource for code is the osf page below... they
supply code for lavaan which can be easily transferred to blavaan:

https://osf.io/4bpmq/

Ed
